i've been playing it for the past 4 days and I haven't experienced any bugs and getting very good frame rates while playing on PC, so all good there.  

BUT, and I can't pinpoint what's wrong with this game, but somehow:
-> the city feels dead, like soulless, almost like a prison you'd want to escape.  It feels like a police state, it's really weird.
-> the excessive swearing and sexual themes and neon just make the whole experience feel cheap and tacky
-> all the physics in the game feel off somehow and so nothing feels like it should (driving is poor, so is shooting mechanics, pretty much everything feels off)

-> the menu UI and color scheme (specially for the map and skill tree) are awful!
-> the lighting in the game is off as well..it's either too bright or too dark

-> the AI is awful.

It may be a lot of little things that are adding up to create an overall poor experience or just a couple of major things, I can't really say, but the whole experience is quite cringe-worthy.
